After being on them for 35 years and on an even keel with them. I'm now to stop taking one patch and eventually all. I tried to make an appointment to talk to the practice head doctors, to put my point accross. After losing one patch, I'm now not only having 2 to 3 days in bed with pain. But now I'm spending 4 and 5 days laid on the sofa. I'm not eating and cannot bear with the pain. After having spinal operation and Claudia equina 25 years ago. I also suffer with depression and anxiety. This has increased my depression and I'm constantly down. Feeling that there is no future. I've written a letter to state that if I do commit suicide, it is down to the head doctors. I couldn't get an appointment with them and was told by message that this was going to happen, and they would not change their minds. I was put on these, not by a doctor but by a pain specialist, I've tried spinal stimulators and everything else. But no tablet can reach the central nervous system to block the pain signals getting to my brain. Tablet are to stop pain after your brain says you are in pain. I've contacted NHS and was told that there is no limit to the daily amount of morphine. Even though my patches are not morphine. I'm now looking into getting medication off of the street if this helps. No option. If I was a druggy I would get help. If one of the doctors pets was in pain I'm sure it would get pain relief. My own doctor I see is brilliant but I'm going to take this further and it's on my social media now.
